name: route-sheet
title: Driver route sheet
for_each: select id,name from delivery.routes where status<>'cancelled' order by name

sections.title: Dispatcher release
sections.note: Planned times from supplied estimates. Confirm road access, load restraints, rest stops and actual work history before departure.

sections.title: Stops
sections.sql: select s.sequence,o.name,o.address,o.units,to_char(make_time(s.arrival_minute/60,s.arrival_minute%60,0),'HH24:MI') planned_service,o.status,o.notes from delivery.stops s join delivery.orders o on o.id=s.order_id where s.route_id=$1 order by s.sequence

sections.title: Travel and rest plan
sections.sql: select e->>'kind' activity,e->>'place' location,e->>'start' start_time,e->>'end' end_time from delivery.routes r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.timeline) e where r.id=$1

name: delivery-exceptions
title: Delivery exception report
for_each: select id,name from delivery.drivers order by name

sections.title: Assigned delivery outcomes
sections.sql: select r.name route,o.name customer,o.status,o.notes from delivery.routes r join delivery.stops s on s.route_id=r.id join delivery.orders o on o.id=s.order_id where r.driver_id=$1 and o.status='failed'

sections.title: Recorded work intervals
sections.note: Recorded intervals are not an approved logbook. Reconcile all other work and previous periods.
sections.sql: select started_at,ended_at,kind,evidence from delivery.work where driver_id=$1 order by started_at
